subject.title: Desktop dependency, signing, notarization and publish safety

independentReview.closedFinding: Automatic stable publishing from v* tag pushes was removed. Publishing now requires manual dispatch, explicit confirmation, draft/prerelease selection, a desktop-release environment and job-scoped write permission.

verification.evidence: Desktop 1288/1288; lint 0 errors and 347 warnings below ceiling 358; workspace, Marketplace API and CLI builds pass.

Hono resolves and packages at 2.0.12. ASAR contains no brace-expansion. pnpm audit exits 1 for brace-expansion@2.1.3, whose exact installed source and bounded 128 MB test demonstrate the CVE maxLength backport; no audit-clean claim is made.
Unsigned NSIS packaging with --publish never passed; the unpacked app launched with a temporary profile and mounted the fail-closed login boundary.
Signing secret presence is fail-closed, notarization/hardened runtime are enabled, workflow is manual-only and stable publication is technically excluded.
